name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Anders goes with exactly one of Callisto, Titan, or Regolith.

Rios, Ganymede, and Algae belong to different colonists.
Rios, Callisto, and Plankton belong to different colonists.
Titan goes with none of Okafor, Rios, or Regolith.
